    max_heap = []

        # Push the current number into the heap
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, -num)
        # If the heap size exceeds k, pop the largest element
        if len(max_heap) > k:
            heapq.heappop(max_heap)
    # The root of the heap is the k-th smallest element
    return -max_heap[0]

        lv = find(v)
        if lu != lv:
            # Lower the label of u to the minimum of its label and v's label
            labels[u] = min(lu, lv)
            # Lower the label of v to the minimum of its label and u's label
            labels[v] = min(lu, lv)
    
    # Repeat until no changes occur
    changed = True
    while changed:

        for u, v in edges:

            lv = find(v)
            if lu != lv:

                labels[u] = min(lu, lv)
                labels[v] = min(lu, lv)

        if root.right:
            root.max_end = max(root.max_end, root.right.max_end)
        
        return root
    
    # Insert an interval into the tree
    def insert(node, interval):
        if not node:
            return IntervalTreeNode(interval[0], interval[1])
        
        # Decide to go left or right based on start time
        if interval[0] < node.start:
            node.left = insert(node.left, interval)
        else:

        # Update max_end for current node

        return node
